description: This Java source file defines a final class MetricsTags that provides enums and static methods for creating and managing metric tags used in monitoring, including endpoint types, component types, processing outcomes, TTD statuses, QoS levels, and message directions, as well as utility methods for generating tag sets for services and protocol adapters.

classes.name: MetricsTags
classes.description: Provides enums and static methods for creating metric tags related to endpoint types, component types, processing outcomes, TTD statuses, QoS levels, and message directions, used for monitoring and metrics reporting.

classes.name: MetricsTags.EndpointType
classes.description: Enum representing different endpoint types (TELEMETRY, EVENT, COMMAND, COMMAND_RESPONSE, UNKNOWN) with methods to get associated tags and parse from string.

classes.name: MetricsTags.ComponentType
classes.description: Enum representing component types (SERVICE, ADAPTER) with methods to get associated tags.

classes.name: MetricsTags.ProcessingOutcome
classes.description: Enum representing processing outcomes (FORWARDED, UNDELIVERABLE, UNPROCESSABLE) with methods to get tags and derive outcome from exceptions.

classes.name: MetricsTags.TtdStatus
classes.description: Enum representing TTD statuses (NONE, EXPIRED, COMMAND) with methods to get associated tags.

classes.name: MetricsTags.QoS
classes.description: Enum representing QoS levels (UNKNOWN, AT_MOST_ONCE, AT_LEAST_ONCE) with methods to get tags and derive QoS from integer level.

classes.name: MetricsTags.Direction
classes.description: Enum representing message directions (ONE_WAY, REQUEST, RESPONSE) with methods to get associated tags.

methods.name: forProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates default metric tags for a protocol adapter given its name.

methods.name: forService
methods.description: Creates default metric tags for a service given its name.

methods.name: getTenantTag
methods.description: Creates a tag for a tenant identifier, ensuring the tenant string is not null.
